## Okuma OSP 5020: Diagnosing and Fixing flyback transformer whine

If your Okuma CNC with OSP 5020 is showing flyback transformer whine, you're not alone. This is the most common failure mode for CRTs that have exceeded their 10-15 year design life.

## What's Happening

The OSP 5020 CRT was manufactured between 1988-2003. After 20+ years, the internal components naturally degrade. high-pitched noise from failing HV section.

## The Solution

An LCD replacement module connects via the existing 14-pin or 20-pin and draws DC 24V from the original cable. Installation takes ~15 minutes with no CNC parameter changes.

## Cost Comparison

| Option | Cost | Lifespan |
|--------|------|----------|
| CRT repair | $$229 (each) | 3-12 months |
| LCD module | $229 (one-time) | 5-7 years |

Five years of CRT repairs cost 5-10x what one LCD module costs.

Full guide: https://cncdisplay.com/brands/OKUMA.html
